therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: DNA damage repair inhibition combined with T-cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with triple-negative breast cancer or ovarian cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase 1: dose-limiting toxicities; Phase 2: objective response rate by RECIST v1.1

results.effect_size: ORR 15.1% (95% CI: 7.7-25.6) in ovarian cancer; ORR 18.2% (95% CI: 10.2-28.9) in TNBC
results.target_engagement_evidence: Niraparib plasma concentrations achieved therapeutic levels with dose-proportional exposure
subgroup_findings: DCR 58.5% in ovarian cancer vs 41.8% in TNBC
results.dose_information: Phase 1: niraparib 200mg or 300mg daily + pembrolizumab; Phase 2: niraparib 200mg daily + pembrolizumab, 21-day cycles
